prompt: Some people think that students should learn from teachers in a classroom, while others believe that online learning is a better way to study. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
People have different views about how students should learn. Some people think students should learn from teachers in a classroom. Others believe online learning is better. In my opinion, learning in a classroom is better because students can get help from the teacher.

People who support online learning have one good reason: it is easy to study at any time. Students do not go to school, so they do not waste time on the road. For example, a student can study at night after his work. He can learn when he feels fresh, and this helps him remember more. This is good for people who are busy, which makes learning easier for them. Because of this, many students finish their lessons and do not stop studying. So online learning helps students who have little free time.

However, I believe that learning in a classroom is better, because students can ask the teacher for help. For example, a student does not understand a math problem. In the classroom, he asks the teacher, and the teacher explains it in two minutes. The teacher sees his face, so he knows when the student is confused. Online, he may wait a long time for an answer. This makes the student feel lost, and he may stop trying. Because of this, students in a classroom learn faster and make fewer mistakes. This is why I think the classroom is better.

In conclusion, online learning is easy and saves time for busy students. However, I believe that learning in a classroom is better, because students can get help from the teacher quickly. This is why the classroom is the better choice.
